items.title: fix(codex): stop service refresh from repeatedly aborting startup (#1…
items.summary: fix(codex): stop service refresh from repeatedly aborting startup (#149365) Related: #127778 ## What Problem This Solves A desktop-control refresh can repeatedly abort startup when copying a signed bundle emits notifications without changing its settled fingerprint. ## Why This Change Was Made Both copy paths wait for the existing generation owner, then retain the original startup guard. The service rechecks its staging directory. Generation state has one writer; artifact reconciliation serializes work per isolated home. ## User Impact A valid refresh completes so the agent can start. A changed generation still rejects startup and preserves prior artifacts. ## Evidence Two base startups each failed after 167 native-copy notifications, retaining a synthetic prior target. The signed source, native copy, reconciliation and app-server were real. The candidate initialized build 1001067 once with the same notification count and unchanged epoch/fingerprint. The current-service control initialized with zero notifications. Two real Gateway turns completed. The first recovered one selection retry; the second had none. The first retry is unattributed; this does not prove every first startup is retry-free. ## Compatibility Service: +8 lines for the wait and staging check. Cache: +4 for its wait. Signed identity, cancellation, ownership, rollback and competing-installer guards remain. No configuration or migration change. Growth accepted under the owner's standing acceptance (2026-09-15). ## Consumers Agent startup and explicit Computer Use install share reconciliation. Current artifacts keep their fast path. ## Invalidation No new timer or retry. The owner's existing quiet interval has no total deadline; continued source activity can extend settlement. ## Tests Four cases enter `createIsolatedCodexAppServerClient` with real reconciliation and copies. They retain initialization, rejection, artifact-preservation and cleanup checks. Removing the waits fails both unchanged-generation cases with the production error; changed-generation controls pass. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/codex/src/app-server/{computer-use-startup,computer-use-service,computer-use-cache,shared-client}.test.ts`: 157 passed. Hosted selection is exactly once; full test inventory has no gaps or duplicates. Earlier merged-source proof passed 296 tests and a full build. Production bytes are unchanged by this test correction. Preflight and structural checks passed. ## Follow-ups - Attribute the first Gateway selection retry if it recurs. - Add cancellation and ownership-rebind coverage with the new wait held. Co-authored-by: Benjamin Badejo Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: VPN服務商Surfshark內部測試伺服器遭駭，未波及用戶資料
items.summary: VPN與網路安全服務商Surfshark於9月9日揭露資安事件，該公司內部測試伺服器因配置錯誤暴露於網際網路，遭攻擊者存取，該伺服器屬工程測試環境，與提供Surfshark VPN等服務的正式環境分離，未儲存或處理用戶資料，因此沒有用戶受到影響，也未造成VPN服務、流量或瀏覽活動資訊外洩。

items.title: Mozilla發布Firefox 156，修補73個資安漏洞
items.summary: Mozilla於9月15日發布Firefox瀏覽器156版，並修補73個漏洞，包含29個高風險漏洞。就漏洞涉及的元件來看，這次Firefox修補以圖形相關元件最多，包括Graphics與Graphics: CanvasWebGL在內合計有15個漏洞；次之是Widget: Win32與Networking，各有6個與4個漏洞。

items.title: 美國加密貨幣監管法案CLARITY Act參議院闖關失敗
items.summary: 美國參議院周二（9/15）表決加密貨幣監管法案《CLARITY Act》，最終僅獲49票支持、50票反對，未達推進法案所需的60票門檻。法案闖關失敗後，比特幣一度跌破7.5萬美元，以太幣跌逾5%，XRP更重挫逾10%。 CLARITY Act主要是用來建立美國加密貨幣市場監管架構，包括釐清證券交易委員會（SEC）與商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）的監管權責，以及加密貨幣業者應遵循的規範，眾議院已於去年7月通過該法案，兩黨經過數月協商仍未取得共識，在參議院被擋了下來。
